propositions: The config key `verify.overlap_enabled` lacks documentation in docs/config.md despite being opt-in and spending LLM tokens proportional to tracker size.

The key name describes an internal mechanism (overlap detection) rather than the user-visible product (duplicate ticket suggestions), making it misleading when read alongside blocking gates like `require_plan_review_for_claim`.

Rename `verify.overlap_enabled` to `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` with permanent TOML alias via `_ALIASES` and permanent env alias via `_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES` to preserve backward compatibility for live configs.
Two permanent deprecation registry entries must be added (cfg:verify.overlap_enabled and env:REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED) with `permanent=True` to classify both as renames, not scheduled removals.
Update all in-source readers (enrich_drain.py:233, plan_review/__init__.py:765) and repo config (rebar.toml:39) to use the new canonical name, preserving old name only in the four back-compat sites.
